get.description: Same fresh admin/read scope. At least 2 search characters; max 100. Literal bounded name/phone match returns <=30 client IDs/names/phones, never ID/address; <=200 active same-org admin/agent assignees and current default ID.

200.description: Successful JSON response or protected export (per domain guide).

post.description: Phase D admin-only atomic booking. Requires existing admin/manage/property-write plus leads/invoices/documents read+write. Strict structural/temporal validation shared with browser; published active available plot, exact expected map/price/currency, same-org client/agent. UUID requestKey scoped to org+actor provides exact-input replay; BEGIN IMMEDIATE + conditional status update + unique active booking prevent races. CRM client/lead, unpaid token invoice, actual private PDFs/uploads, actor audit and in-app notifications commit/roll back together. No payment, receipt, sale or ledger posting. See docs/PLOT_MAP_PHASE_D.md.

200.description: Exact same-actor/request-key replay; replayed:true with original bookingId, current plot details and issued files. No duplicate side effects.

201.description: New booking and all side effects committed. Contains bookingId, replayed:false and private plot details.

403.description: Permission, identity scope or origin denied.

409.description: Plot just booked/nonavailable, stale publication/price/currency, encumbrance, changed client, or key reused with different terms. No partial business writes; refresh details/map.

413.description: Streamed JSON body exceeds 6 MiB. Maximum 2 base64 attachments, each decoded <=2 MiB; PDF/PNG/JPEG signature required.

bookingDate.description: Today in Asia/Karachi; no backdating/future booking.

expiryDate.description: Future within 90 days for reserve; null for book.

firstDueDate.description: Empty for full; valid date after booking for installment.

patch.description: Same fresh Phase D permissions. Revision-CAS confirm/cancel/extend with required reason. Only the active source-linked D booking can mutate; legacy records read-only. Pending holds can confirm before expiry or extend forward within 90 days; explicit cancel releases plot and cancels unpaid token invoice without deleting client/CRM/history/files or asserting refunds. No automatic expiry or sale conversion.

200.description: Successful JSON response or protected export (per domain guide).

403.description: Permission, identity scope or origin denied.

409.description: Stale/closed/legacy booking, invalid plot state, elapsed hold on confirm, or ownership/sale/resale encumbrance.

get.description: Same fresh admin/read scope. Actual private booking PDF/PNG/JPEG bytes after org+plot+booking+document binding. Attachment-only, sandbox CSP, nosniff, private/no-store and audited. No storage credentials/public original locators. 120/user/org/15min.

200.description: Successful JSON response or protected export (per domain guide).

403.description: Permission, identity scope or origin denied.

get.description: Phase D private admin-only plot record: canonical catalogue, latest 50 booking records with authorized client identity, invoice/file metadata, latest 100 safe plot/booking activity events. No SVG bytes, source originals, sale/ownership records or file contents. No public/agent access until Phase E; private/no-store.

200.description: Successful JSON response or protected export (per domain guide).

403.description: Permission, identity scope or origin denied.

get.description: Authenticated personal scope is derived from current role and database-linked user profiles; no client identity override. Without resource returns summary/staff consent options; with resource returns paged minimized records. Staff cannot request personal collections.

post.description: Administrator explicitly links/unlinks existing profiles and matching-role accounts after offline identity verification; changes are audited. Independent agent/staff approvals are still required.
